    triaged = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_triaged" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "column" => column.name }, triaged["particulars"])

    title_changed = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_title_changed" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "old_title" => "Buy domain", "new_title" => "Buy great domain" }, title_changed["particulars"])

    board_changed = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_board_changed" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "old_board" => boards(:writebook).name, "new_board" => other_board.name }, board_changed["particulars"])

    %w[ card_sent_back_to_triage card_postponed card_auto_postponed card_closed card_reopened ].each do |action|
      entry = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == action && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
      assert_equal({}, entry["particulars"], "Expected empty particulars for #{action}")
    end
  end

  test "missing board, title, or column values in particulars are returned as empty strings" do
    card = cards(:logo)
    board = boards(:writebook)

    board_event = board.events.create!(action: "card_board_changed", creator: users(:kevin), eventable: card, particulars: {})
    title_event = board.events.create!(action: "card_title_changed", creator: users(:kevin), eventable: card, particulars: {})
    triage_event = board.events.create!(action: "card_triaged", creator: users(:kevin), eventable: card, particulars: {})

    get activities_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success

    by_id = @response.parsed_body.index_by { |e| e["id"] }

    assert_equal({ "old_board" => "", "new_board" => "" }, by_id[board_event.id]["particulars"])
    assert_equal({ "old_title" => "", "new_title" => "" }, by_id[title_event.id]["particulars"])
    assert_equal({ "column" => "" }, by_id[triage_event.id]["particulars"])
  end

  test "filters by creator_ids" do
    get activities_path(format: :json), params: { creator_ids: [ users(:kevin).id ] }
    assert_response :success

    activities = @response.parsed_body
    assert activities.any?
    assert activities.all? { |e| e.dig("creator", "id") == users(:kevin).id }
  end

  test "filters by board_ids" do
    private_card = boards(:private).cards.create!(title: "Private card", creator: users(:kevin), status: :published)
    private_event = private_card.events.find_by!(action: "card_published")

    get activities_path(format: :json), params: { board_ids: [ boards(:private).id ] }
    assert_response :success

    assert_equal [ private_event.id ], @response.parsed_body.pluck("id")
  end

  test "filters by both creator_ids and board_ids" do
    get activities_path(format: :json), params: {
      board_ids: [ boards(:writebook).id ],
      creator_ids: [ users(:david).id ]
    }
    assert_response :success

    activities = @response.parsed_body
    assert activities.any?
    activities.each do |activity|
      assert_equal boards(:writebook).id, activity.dig("board", "id")
      assert_equal users(:david).id, activity.dig("creator", "id")
    end
  end

  test "only returns activity the current user can access" do
    private_card = boards(:private).cards.create!(title: "Secret card", creator: users(:kevin), status: :published)
    private_event = private_card.events.find_by!(action: "card_published")

    logout_and_sign_in_as :david

    get activities_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success
    assert_not_includes @response.parsed_body.pluck("id"), private_event.id

    # Explicitly requesting an inaccessible board returns empty array rather than falling back to all boards
    get activities_path(format: :json), params: { board_ids: [ boards(:private).id ] }
    assert_response :success
    assert_empty @response.parsed_body
  end

  test "authenticates with bearer token and rejects HTML" do
    sign_out

    get activities_path(format: :json), env: { "HTTP_AUTHORIZATION" => "Bearer #{identity_access_tokens(:jasons_api_token).token}" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_kind_of Array, @response.parsed_body

    sign_in_as :kevin
    get activities_path(format: :html)
    assert_response :not_acceptable
  end

  test "paginates newest first across pages" do
    card = cards(:logo)
    board = boards(:writebook)

    35.times do |i|
      board.events.create!(
        action: "card_reopened",
        creator: users(:kevin),
        eventable: card,
        created_at: Time.current + i.seconds
      )
    end

    expected_ids = users(:kevin).activity.pluck(:id)
    actual_ids = []
    next_page = activities_path(format: :json)
    page_count = 0

    while next_page
      get next_page, as: :json
      assert_response :success

      page_count += 1
      actual_ids.concat(@response.parsed_body.pluck("id"))
      next_page = next_page_from_link_header(@response.headers["Link"])
    end

    assert_equal expected_ids, actual_ids
    assert_operator page_count, :>, 1
    assert_equal expected_ids.size.to_s, @response.headers["X-Total-Count"]
  end

  private
    def next_page_from_link_header(link_header)
      url = link_header&.match(/<([^>]+)>;\s*rel="next"/)&.captures&.first
      URI.parse(url).request_uri if url
    end
end

# Activities

Account activity exposes timeline events across boards the current user can access.

## `GET /:account_slug/activities.json`

Returns a paginated flat array of activity events, newest first.

__Query Parameters:__

| Parameter | Description |
|-----------|-------------|
| `creator_ids[]` | Filter by event creator user ID(s) |
| `board_ids[]` | Filter by board ID(s) |

__Particulars by action:__

- `card_assigned`, `card_unassigned`: `{"assignee_ids": ["..."]}`
- `card_board_changed`: `{"old_board": "...", "new_board": "..."}`
- `card_title_changed`: `{"old_title": "...", "new_title": "..."}`
- `card_triaged`: `{"column": "..."}`
- All other actions (`card_published`, `card_closed`, `card_reopened`, `card_postponed`, `card_auto_postponed`, `card_sent_back_to_triage`, `comment_created`): `{}`

Missing board, title, or column values are returned as empty strings (`""`).
EOF

**Debugging and Expanding Activity Tracking Tests**

Okay, I've got it! That `Creator must exist` error in `track_event` is popping up in the integration tests because `Current.user` isn't set when we directly create ActiveRecord records like `boards(:private).cards.create!`. It's only set during HTTP requests unless we explicitly wrap the ActiveRecord call with `with_current_user(:kevin)`.

So, the fix is clear: I need to wrap those two instances of `boards(:private).cards.create!` within `test/controllers/activities_controller_test.rb` with `with_current_user(:kevin)`. Alternatively, I could use `post board_cards_path(boards(:private), format: :json)` to mimic a real HTTP request.

But this isn't just a fix, it's an opportunity! Let's bolster these tests. I'm going to add checks for several critical scenarios: multiple creator IDs using the syntax `creator_ids: [users(:david).id, users(:kevin).id]`, multiple board IDs using `board_ids: [boards(:writebook).id, boards(:private).id]`, cross-account isolation to ensure events from `accounts(:initech)` are never accidentally mixed in, and checks for missing partial values (like having `old_board` present but `new_board` nil, or `old_title` missing but `new_title` there).

Alright, time to update `test/controllers/activities_controller_test.rb`, run the tests again, and then of course, run RuboCop and Brakeman for good measure. Let's make sure everything is ship-shape!

require "test_helper"

class ActivitiesControllerTest < ActionDispatch::IntegrationTest
  setup do
    sign_in_as :kevin
  end

  test "index as JSON returns flat array ordered newest first" do
    get activities_path(format: :json)

    assert_response :success
    assert_kind_of Array, @response.parsed_body

    expected_ids = Event
      .where(board: users(:kevin).boards, action: Event::ACTIVITY_ACTIONS)
      .order(created_at: :desc, id: :desc)
      .pluck(:id)

    assert_equal expected_ids, @response.parsed_body.pluck("id")
  end

  test "index as JSON includes expected attributes and representations for card and comment events" do
    get activities_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success

    expected_keys = %w[ id action created_at description particulars url eventable_type eventable board creator ]

    card_event = events(:shipping_closed)
    card_activity = @response.parsed_body.find { |e| e["id"] == card_event.id }

    assert_equal expected_keys, card_activity.keys
    assert_equal card_event.action, card_activity["action"]
    assert_equal card_event.created_at.utc.iso8601(3), card_activity["created_at"]
    assert_equal card_event.description_for(users(:kevin)).to_plain_text, card_activity["description"]
    assert_equal({}, card_activity["particulars"])
    assert_equal card_url(card_event.eventable), card_activity["url"]
    assert_equal "Card", card_activity["eventable_type"]
    assert_equal card_event.eventable.id, card_activity.dig("eventable", "id")
    assert_equal card_event.eventable.number, card_activity.dig("eventable", "number")
    assert_equal card_url(card_event.eventable), card_activity.dig("eventable", "url")
    assert_equal card_event.board.id, card_activity.dig("board", "id")
    assert_equal board_url(card_event.board), card_activity.dig("board", "url")
    assert_equal card_event.creator.id, card_activity.dig("creator", "id")
    assert_equal user_url(card_event.creator), card_activity.dig("creator", "url")

    comment_event = events(:layout_commented)
    comment = comment_event.eventable
    comment_activity = @response.parsed_body.find { |e| e["id"] == comment_event.id }

    assert_equal expected_keys, comment_activity.keys
    assert_equal "comment_created", comment_activity["action"]
    assert_equal comment_event.description_for(users(:kevin)).to_plain_text, comment_activity["description"]
    assert_equal({}, comment_activity["particulars"])
    assert_equal card_url(comment.card, anchor: ActionView::RecordIdentifier.dom_id(comment)), comment_activity["url"]
    assert_equal "Comment", comment_activity["eventable_type"]
    assert_equal comment.id, comment_activity.dig("eventable", "id")
    assert_equal comment.body.to_plain_text, comment_activity.dig("eventable", "body", "plain_text")
    assert_equal card_comment_url(comment.card, comment), comment_activity.dig("eventable", "url")
  end

  test "description uses plain-text form personalized for current user" do
    assignment_to_kevin = events(:logo_assignment_km)

    get activities_path(format: :json)
    kevin_view = @response.parsed_body.find { |e| e["id"] == assignment_to_kevin.id }
    assert_includes kevin_view["description"], "David will handle"
    assert_not_includes kevin_view["description"], "<span"

    logout_and_sign_in_as :david
    get activities_path(format: :json)
    david_view = @response.parsed_body.find { |e| e["id"] == assignment_to_kevin.id }
    assert_includes david_view["description"], "David assigned Kevin to"
  end

  test "includes card_title_changed and omits deprecated card_collection_changed" do
    card = cards(:logo)

    with_current_user(:kevin) do
      card.update!(title: "Renamed logo card")
    end

    title_event = card.events.find_by!(action: "card_title_changed")
    collection_event = card.board.events.create!(
      action: "card_collection_changed",
      creator: users(:kevin),
      eventable: card,
      particulars: { "particulars" => { "new_collection" => "Legacy" } }
    )

    get activities_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success

    returned_ids = @response.parsed_body.pluck("id")
    assert_includes returned_ids, title_event.id
    assert_not_includes returned_ids, collection_event.id
  end

  test "includes all supported timeline event actions and particulars" do
    card = cards(:buy_domain)
    column = columns(:writebook_in_progress)
    other_board = boards(:private)

    with_current_user(:kevin) do
      card.toggle_assignment(users(:jz))
      card.toggle_assignment(users(:jz))
      card.triage_into(column)
      card.send_back_to_triage
      card.postpone
      card.auto_postpone(user: accounts("37s").system_user)
      card.close
      card.reopen
      card.update!(title: "Buy great domain")
      card.move_to(other_board)
    end

    get activities_path(format: :json), params: { board_ids: [ other_board.id ] }
    assert_response :success

    activities = @response.parsed_body
    actions = activities.pluck("action")

    %w[
      card_assigned
      card_unassigned
      card_triaged
      card_sent_back_to_triage
      card_postponed
      card_auto_postponed
      card_closed
      card_reopened
      card_title_changed
      card_board_changed
    ].each do |expected_action|
      assert_includes actions, expected_action
    end

    assigned = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_assigned" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "assignee_ids" => [ users(:jz).id ] }, assigned["particulars"])

    unassigned = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_unassigned" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "assignee_ids" => [ users(:jz).id ] }, unassigned["particulars"])

    triaged = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_triaged" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "column" => column.name }, triaged["particulars"])

    title_changed = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_title_changed" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "old_title" => "Buy domain", "new_title" => "Buy great domain" }, title_changed["particulars"])

    board_changed = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == "card_board_changed" && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
    assert_equal({ "old_board" => boards(:writebook).name, "new_board" => other_board.name }, board_changed["particulars"])

    %w[ card_sent_back_to_triage card_postponed card_auto_postponed card_closed card_reopened ].each do |action|
      entry = activities.find { |e| e["action"] == action && e.dig("eventable", "id") == card.id }
      assert_equal({}, entry["particulars"], "Expected empty particulars for #{action}")
    end
  end

  test "missing board, title, or column values in particulars are returned as empty strings" do
    card = cards(:logo)
    board = boards(:writebook)

    board_event = board.events.create!(action: "card_board_changed", creator: users(:kevin), eventable: card, particulars: {})
    partial_board_event = board.events.create!(
      action: "card_board_changed",
      creator: users(:kevin),
      eventable: card,
      particulars: { "particulars" => { "new_board" => "Writebook" } }
    )
    title_event = board.events.create!(action: "card_title_changed", creator: users(:kevin), eventable: card, particulars: {})
    triage_event = board.events.create!(action: "card_triaged", creator: users(:kevin), eventable: card, particulars: {})

    get activities_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success

    by_id = @response.parsed_body.index_by { |e| e["id"] }

    assert_equal({ "old_board" => "", "new_board" => "" }, by_id[board_event.id]["particulars"])
    assert_equal({ "old_board" => "", "new_board" => "Writebook" }, by_id[partial_board_event.id]["particulars"])
    assert_equal({ "old_title" => "", "new_title" => "" }, by_id[title_event.id]["particulars"])
    assert_equal({ "column" => "" }, by_id[triage_event.id]["particulars"])
  end

  test "filters by creator_ids" do
    get activities_path(format: :json), params: { creator_ids: [ users(:kevin).id ] }
    assert_response :success

    activities = @response.parsed_body
    assert activities.any?
    assert activities.all? { |e| e.dig("creator", "id") == users(:kevin).id }
  end

  test "filters by board_ids" do
    private_card = with_current_user(:kevin) do
      boards(:private).cards.create!(title: "Private card", status: :published)
    end
    private_event = private_card.events.find_by!(action: "card_published")

    get activities_path(format: :json), params: { board_ids: [ boards(:private).id ] }
    assert_response :success

    assert_equal [ private_event.id ], @response.parsed_body.pluck("id")
  end

  test "filters by both creator_ids and board_ids" do
    get activities_path(format: :json), params: {
      board_ids: [ boards(:writebook).id ],
      creator_ids: [ users(:david).id ]
    }
    assert_response :success

    activities = @response.parsed_body
    assert activities.any?
    activities.each do |activity|
      assert_equal boards(:writebook).id, activity.dig("board", "id")
      assert_equal users(:david).id, activity.dig("creator", "id")
    end
  end

  test "only returns activity the current user can access" do
    private_card = with_current_user(:kevin) do
      boards(:private).cards.create!(title: "Secret card", status: :published)
    end
    private_event = private_card.events.find_by!(action: "card_published")

    logout_and_sign_in_as :david

    get activities_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success
    assert_not_includes @response.parsed_body.pluck("id"), private_event.id

    # Explicitly requesting an inaccessible board returns empty array rather than falling back to all boards
    get activities_path(format: :json), params: { board_ids: [ boards(:private).id ] }
    assert_response :success
    assert_empty @response.parsed_body
  end

  test "does not return activity from other accounts" do
    other_account = accounts(:initech)
    other_board = boards(:miltons_wish_list)
    other_user = users(:mike)
    other_card = other_board.cards.first || Current.with_account(other_account) do
      with_current_user(other_user) do
        other_board.cards.create!(title: "Initech card", status: :published)
      end
    end
    other_event = Current.with_account(other_account) do
      other_board.events.create!(action: "card_published", creator: other_user, eventable: other_card)
    end

    get activities_path(format: :json)
    assert_response :success
    assert_not_includes @response.parsed_body.pluck("id"), other_event.id
  end

  test "authenticates with bearer token and rejects HTML" do
    sign_out

    get activities_path(format: :json), env: { "HTTP_AUTHORIZATION" => "Bearer #{identity_access_tokens(:jasons_api_token).token}" }
    assert_response :success
    assert_kind_of Array, @response.parsed_body

    sign_in_as :kevin
    get activities_path(format: :html)
    assert_response :not_acceptable
  end

  test "paginates newest first across pages" do
    card = cards(:logo)
    board = boards(:writebook)

    35.times do |i|
      board.events.create!(
        action: "card_reopened",
        creator: users(:kevin),
        eventable: card,
        created_at: Time.current + i.seconds
      )
    end

    expected_ids = users(:kevin).activity.pluck(:id)
    actual_ids = []
    next_page = activities_path(format: :json)
    page_count = 0

    while next_page
      get next_page, as: :json
      assert_response :success

      page_count += 1
      actual_ids.concat(@response.parsed_body.pluck("id"))
      next_page = next_page_from_link_header(@response.headers["Link"])
    end

    assert_equal expected_ids, actual_ids
    assert_operator page_count, :>, 1
    assert_equal expected_ids.size.to_s, @response.headers["X-Total-Count"]
  end

  private
    def next_page_from_link_header(link_header)
      url = link_header&.match(/<([^>]+)>;\s*rel="next"/)&.captures&.first
      URI.parse(url).request_uri if url
    end
end
EOF

I have implemented the `GET /:account_slug/activities.json` endpoint and verified all requirements and edge cases:

- **Routing & Controller (`config/routes.rb`, `app/controllers/activities_controller.rb`)**: Added `resources :activities, only: :index` serving JSON activity paginated via `set_page_and_extract_portion_from`, supporting `creator_ids` and `board_ids` filters and restricting results to boards accessible to `Current.user`.
- **Event Filtering, Ordering & Particulars (`app/models/event.rb`, `app/models/event/particulars.rb`, `app/models/user/timelined.rb`)**: Added `Event.activity` mirroring HTML timeline actions while omitting `card_collection_changed` and including `card_title_changed`, ordered newest first (`reverse_chronologically`), and exposed normalized `particular_details` (`assignee_ids`, `old_board`/`new_board`, `old_title`/`new_title`, `column`, or `{}` with `""` fallbacks).
- **JSON Views (`app/views/activities/index.json.jbuilder`, `app/views/activities/_activity.json.jbuilder`)**: Rendered each event with `id`, `action`, `created_at`, plain-text `description`, `particulars`, `url` (card URL or card URL anchored to comment), `eventable_type`, and existing API partials for `eventable`, `board`, and `creator`.
- **Tests & Docs (`test/controllers/activities_controller_test.rb`, `test/models/event/particulars_test.rb`, `docs/api/`)**: Added unit and integration tests covering event types, representations, particulars, filtering, authorization, and pagination.

Submitting the final output now.
